answer: A market for yarrow harvest reports and timber counts can give new verifiers voting weight only after they complete paid audits for unrelated buyers. Represent each verifier as a vertex and count at most one audit per buyer with a settled payment. Set a nonrefundable fee on every qualifying audit. An attacker can invent buyers and verifiers, but manufacturing votes then requires paying the fee for each audit on every alias. Price the fee against the value of swaying a vote.
